summary: Crash when zombie tries to spawn second reinforcement
description: Summary The game crashes when a zombie tries to spawn a zombie reinforcement for the second time. (Relates to MC-272321) Steps to Reproduce - Set Difficulty to Hard. - Either: Spawn a leader Zombie. (A zombie have 5 chance of being a leader zombie, which is capable of summoning reinforcements.) Or, spawn a zombie and run the following command to make it a leader: /attribute @e[type=zombie,limit=1] minecraft:zombie.spawn_reinforcements base set 1 - Switch gamemode to Survival. - Attack the zombie using snowballs. (Other projectiles can also be used.) - One reinforcement zombie spawns. - Continue hitting the original zombie with snowballs. Expected Result Game does not crash. Actual Result Game crashes.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Set the game difficulty to Hard.
2. Spawn a leader Zombie or use the command `/attribute @e[type=zombie,limit=1] minecraft:zombie.spawn_reinforcements base set 1` to make an existing zombie into a leader.
3. Switch the gamemode to Survival.
4. Attack the leader zombie using snowballs.
5. Wait for one reinforcement zombie to spawn.
6. Continue hitting the original leader zombie with snowballs.
7. Observe that the game crashes when attempting to spawn a second reinforcement zombie.
Observed Behavior: The game crashes when a zombie tries to spawn a second reinforcement. This issue occurs under specific conditions: the difficulty must be set to Hard, and either a leader zombie must naturally spawn or an ordinary zombie must be turned into a leader using the command `/attribute @e[type=zombie,limit=1] minecraft:zombie.spawn_reinforcements base set 1`. The player should switch to Survival mode and attack the leader zombie with snowballs until one reinforcement spawns. Continuing to hit the original leader zombie will trigger the crash when it attempts to spawn a second reinforcement. This bug results in an unexpected game crash instead of the expected behavior where the game remains stable without crashing.
Expected Behavior: When a leader zombie attempts to spawn a second reinforcement, the game should handle this without crashing. The reinforcement zombie should spawn successfully, allowing for continued combat between the player and the zombies. The game should remain stable throughout these interactions, ensuring that no unexpected crashes occur during normal gameplay.
